Hey /v/survivor friends,

I was thinking about how to differentiate our site from other similar Survivor communities, and one possible way would be to have a vote at the end of the season just between us, to identify the Stoat and Goat of the Season.

As we know, Voat has an affinity to our mascot, the Voat Goat, and in Survivor, the word/animal "goat" also carries with it a charged meaning: the player who has "a highly unlikely chance of winning, whom if taken to the Final Tribal Council should be easily beatable due to the way they played the game or treated the members of the jury" [Redmond] and that "the Goat’s loyalty is insured by a guarantee of 2nd or 3rd place" [Sucks]. In fact, based on the latter link, we at Survivor love our animal comparisons; Shirin from last season making a perfect example with her howler monkey, stingray and dead fish analogy.

I propose we celebrate crowning the Goat of the Season, the player who meets the following criteria:
- had a very minimal (or least) impact on the season strategically and/or socially and/or physically in challenges;
- would have no shot at winning the Final Tribal Council (based on the jury of the season, or hypothetically any jury, if he/she was that bad a player) as shown by evidence seen during the Survivor season;
- BUT is completely memorable; be it for any combination of the following factors: entertainment value, humor, conflict/drama, likability/love-to-hate-ness.
- Note: All players are eligible for this award, including players who did not make the FTC, except for the Sole Survivor.
(edit 02/10/2015 : I suspect we should change this requirement to only players who have made the merge.)

I also propose to crown the Stoat of the Season, (Weasel Woo jokes aside,) based on the following criteria:
- the most memorable player (to not win) who would have had a great shot at winning the Final Tribal Council (based on the jury of the season, or hypothetically any jury, if he/she was that good a player) as shown by evidence seen during the Survivor season;
- who excels far above other players, due to a combination of traits and abilities, strategically, socially or physically in challenges;
- with bonus points for any combination of the following factors: entertainment value, humor, conflict/drama, likability/love-to-hate-ness.
- Note: All players are eligible for this award, including players who did not make the FTC, except for the Sole Survivor.

Why the Stoat? It's a small creature, cute, stealthy and flexible, which faces very little threat to its survival (marked as Least Concern on Wikipedia), and fully capable of taking on prey larger than itself. Also it rhymes with Voat and Goat, haha.

Of course, all criteria above is open to critique and constructive feedback - I would love to clarify the criteria further. One potential addition would be whether pre-merge player should be allowed to qualify, since potentially they might not have enough screentime to be justified for either position (maybe taking Drew Christy as an example). I would likely be in favor of adding a made-the-merge requirement to the list, but not if it takes away from the fun of it all. :P

I imagine after the final episode, we start our preliminary shortlisting to cut the number of candidates for each category down to three, and then we have a week of campaigning, discussing or deliberating, and then we have a final vote. (I'm thinking of instant run-off voting [link] to make it fairer instead of the usual first-past-the-post, but I'm open to suggestions on the best calculation method.)

So... what do you think? :D
